name: Shiomizaki Gakuen Engekibu Koi Pure ~Anata to Ichaicha Roleplaying!~
original_name: 汐見崎学園演劇部　恋ぷれ　～あなたといちゃいちゃろーるぷれいんぐ！～
source:
Shiomizaki Gakuen is a gigantic boarding school with over 1000 students. It prides itself on the learning environment and requires all students to be part of an extracurricular club. Junya transfers to this school to watch over his little sister Kokoa who is starting first year this spring. While walking around the campus to decide on what club to join, they meet the drama club leader Sena. Easily persuaded by Sena’s smooth talk, Kokoa decides to join the club and Junya follows her. However, the drama club doesn’t actually do anything… it’s more like Sena’s private room, complete with a maid Ayuka. One day, Sena suggests that they do a love role play. Is this just acting, or is true love?

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/09/01/september-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
汐见崎学园是一所拥有一千多名学生的大型寄宿制学校。学校以优良的学习环境为傲，并要求所有学生都必须参加课外社团。Junya转入这所学校，是为了照看今年春天刚入学的妹妹Kokoa。两人在校园里四处参观、考虑加入哪个社团时，遇见了戏剧社社长Sena。Kokoa轻易便被Sena巧舌如簧的劝说打动，决定加入戏剧社，Junya也跟着入社。然而，戏剧社其实根本不开展任何活动…那里更像是Sena的私人房间，甚至还有女仆Ayuka随侍。一天，Sena提议大家来演一场恋爱角色扮演。这究竟只是演戏，还是真正的爱情？

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/09/01/september-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
